summary_en: Scroll Corporation cancelled 606,700 common shares on September 30, 2026, representing 1.75% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares totaled 34,022,500.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 30, 2026, Scroll Corporation completed the cancellation of 606,700 common shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 1.75% of the issued shares outstanding before cancellation. Following the completion, the total number of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) was 34,022,500 shares.
